native_review.finding: Stock short slot selection marks empty keyboard/system/consumer reports dirty; QMK unchanged-report suppression can omit them
native_review.assessment: Concrete packet difference. An earlier uninstrumented forced-release test did not appear to reconnect. Later USB diagnostics verified normal transport and incoming encrypted links; the exact empty-report batch changed no observed connection state, and subsequent production cold-start typing worked. No causal reason to add the batch to production was established.
native_review.other_candidates: No demonstrated PD1 pin-release omission; short slot-selection output guard agrees with stock; missing USB notices and B7 response remain unproven causes
